news.title: Coyote vs. Acme Is Finally, Actually, in Theaters. It Wasn’t Easy.
news.description: Director Dave Green explains how Coyote vs. Acme survived being shelved by Warner Bros. and finally made it to theaters.

news.title: Lady Annabel Goldsmith, who was friend of Princess Diana and gave her name to Annabel's nightclub, left £5.6m in will
news.description: The aristocrat, who died aged 91 on October 18 last year, famously lent her name to the upmarket London nightclub Annabel's, which was founded by her first husband Mark Birley.
